name: Barbarian Ki Rager
body:
Some disciplined barbarians use their inner spiritual strength as well as their physical strength to fight. Though they may not call it this way, the power they draw on is what in other lands is known as ki.

Ki Meditation (Ex)

At 4th level, a ki rager gains Ki Meditation as a bonus feat, even if she doesn’t meet the feat’s prerequisites. This replaces the 4th-level rage power. Every time a ki rager could select a new rage power after 4th level, she can choose to gain a new ki feat or Extra Ki instead. She doesn’t have to meet these feats’ prerequisites.

Ki Powers: At 10th and 16th level, a ki rager can choose a ki power from the qinggong monk or unchained monk list, as if she was a monk of her barbarian level -6. She must have enough ki points in her pool to activate the power. This replaces the 10th and 16th-level rage powers. The ki rager has access to the new ki powers listed in Legendary Monks and above.
